select
, (case when tfg.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{planInfo.portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order1 , (case when tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1=#{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order2
, (case when tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2=#{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order3
, 99 as order3
, 99 as order9
,(case when tfg.TERM_TYPE=#{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order4
, 99 order4
,(case when tfg.CUSTOMER_ID= #{planInfo.brokerageNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order5
, 99 order5
,(case when tfg.SEC_ACCT_ID= #{planInfo.secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order6
, 99 order6
,(case when tfg.REGIST_ORG=#{planInfo.registOrg, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order7
, 99 order7
,(case when tfg.TRADE_PLAT= #{planInfo.tradePlatform, jdbcType=VARCHAR} then 1 else 99 end) order8
, 99 order8
from TRD_FEE_CONFIG tfg /* 交易费用配置 */ where tfg.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{feeDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND tfg.TRADE_MARKET = #{planInfo.tradeMarket, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.FEE_TYPE = #{planInfo.feeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.TRADE_TYPE = #{planInfo.tradeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.PS = #{planInfo.ps, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.TERM_TYPE = #{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = #{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = null)
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = #{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = null)
ORDER BY order1, order2, order3, order4, order5, order6, order7, order8, tfg.EFF_DATE
